test_SquadV1Test: test the SquadV1Test class that validates the squad v1.1 dataset builder with train and dev splits
test_SquadV2Test: test the SquadV2Test class that validates the squad v2.0 dataset builder with train and dev splits
test_squad_dataset_builder: test the squad dataset builder module using DatasetBuilderTestCase for v1.1 and v2.0 configs
